description: Unit test script for the Router class in litellm, specifically testing that removing unnecessary dict.copy() calls does not cause side effects in deployment objects. It verifies both asynchronous and synchronous completion methods.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: The Router class imported from litellm, responsible for managing model deployments and completion requests.

methods.name: test_acompletion_deployment_not_mutated()
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying that the deployment object remains unchanged after an async completion request when removing dict.copy().

methods.name: test_completion_deployment_not_mutated()
methods.description: Synchronous test verifying that the deployment object remains unchanged after a sync completion request when removing dict.copy().
